channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: Solana switches to Alpenglow, targeting faster transaction settlement
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on October 21, replacing its voting system and targeting finality in about 150 milliseconds, while wallets and app use stay the same.

item.title: How to Bridge Tokens That Have Transfer Restrictions
item.description: A restricted token can cross chains only if its rules allow the bridge and destination wallet; check both sides and confirm how tokens are issued.

item.title: Standard Chartered signs deal to buy Zodia Custody
item.description: Standard Chartered signed a deal for Zodia Custody, pending approval, bringing its crypto custody business into the bank as its software arm spins out.

item.title: Direct Pools or Aggregators for Repeat Crypto Swaps?
item.description: A direct pool can suit repeat swaps when its liquidity is deep, while an aggregator can find a better route across pools; compare net output each time.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with a voting system that targets 150-millisecond finality while leaving wallets and fees unchanged.

item.title: A confirmed bridge transfer can still be reversed
item.description: A bridge may act on a transfer before its source chain is final, so a reorganisation can leave the destination out of step with the original transaction.

item.title: Why Manta Pacific withdrawals can take days
item.description: A Manta Pacific withdrawal can wait days while Ethereum checks the rollup’s record. The withdrawal stages explain the delay and what to check before you start.

item.title: Swift blockchain ledger readies 17 banks for payment pilots
item.description: Swift says its blockchain ledger is ready for first use, with 17 banks preparing to test cross-border payments using digital bank deposits around the clock.

item.title: Why Impermanent Loss Can Shrink Your Pool Return
item.description: Impermanent loss can shrink a liquidity provider’s return when pool prices move, because the pool holds a different mix of tokens than simply keeping them would.

item.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
item.description: The OCC has finalized federal rules for payment stablecoin issuers, setting reserve, redemption and custody standards ahead of a January 2027 start date.

item.title: How Polygon Bridge transfers work inside an app
item.description: Polygon Bridge transfers need token checks, user approvals and on-chain confirmation; a clear app flow shows what happens on each network and when funds arrive.

item.title: How to choose an omnichain architecture
item.description: Omnichain apps connect contracts on separate blockchains, but teams must choose how messages are checked, delivered and handled when a chain stalls.

item.title: Mastercard opens AI agent payment tools to developers
item.description: Mastercard opened developer access to agent payment tools after pilots with Coinbase, Base and others, showing how software could buy online services within set budgets.

item.title: Arbswap: four ways to swap and supply liquidity
item.description: Arbswap connects token swaps, liquidity pools, farming and cross-network trades on Arbitrum, but each route suits a different job and carries its own trade-offs.

item.title: A small test transfer can make a bridge trip safer
item.description: A small test transfer can reveal a wrong network, address or route before you move more crypto, but it adds a fee and does not remove bridge risk.

item.title: JPMorgan brings its dollar deposit token to Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan has brought its dollar deposit token to Ethereum, giving institutional clients another public network for on-chain transfers alongside Base for payments.

item.title: Polkadot DAO proposal puts dotUSD at center of user push
item.description: A Polkadot governance proposal puts dotUSD and a new product platform at the center of a plan to attract everyday users and tie app use to DOT demand.

item.title: Babylon Seeks Aave Approval for Bitcoin-Backed Loans
item.description: Babylon has proposed letting Aave V4 users borrow stablecoins against native Bitcoin held in vaults, pending review and approval by Aave DAO.

item.title: Coinbase and Marqeta team up on stablecoin-backed cards
item.description: Coinbase will hold and convert stablecoins for Marqeta card programs, with Base handling settlement and businesses able to let customers spend token balances.

item.title: A token blacklist can stop a cross-chain transfer
item.description: A token blacklist can stop a cross-chain transfer at the source or destination, so check which contract controls the token and what the bridge does next.
